title: Wolken-Modul — interactive Grundner et al. 2024 cloud-cover diagnostic
description: Interactive live diagnosis of the Grundner et al. (2024, JAMES) symbolic-regression cloud-cover equation, ported 1:1 from GenesisAeon's TheorieArbeit Wolken-Modul.md and its independently verified DYAMOND coefficients (R^2 = 0.94, 11 trainable parameters) -- all nine coefficients plus epsilon, RH-bar and T-bar cross-checked against the primary-source PDF, not invented. Implements all three additive terms (I1, I2, I3) plus the paper's physical constraints (PC1-PC3), explicitly labelled in-app as a diagnostic closure, not a forecast. Part of the GenesisAeon interactive-sandbox series.
